name: Pisco sour
description: Pisco shaken with lime, syrup and egg white into a foam-topped cocktail.

ayurveda.note: Madya is ushna in a high degree.

histamine.note: Spirit plus raw egg white and lime.

nutrition.highlight: the foam is raw egg white

effects.note: Alcohol measurably slows reaction time and narrows attention at ordinary drinking doses, well before intoxication feels subjectively obvious — one of the most consistently replicated findings in pharmacology, and the reason legal drink-driving limits exist at all. Built on a full measure of pisco, it delivers as much alcohol as a straight spirit despite tasting diluted by lime and egg white. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
